title: Hermite degree indices
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a natural number $k$, let $I_{n,k}$ be the finite set of multi-indices $\alpha:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb{N}$ whose total degree satisfies $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\alpha_i\le k$.
